title: Rennlist - Porsche 993 body dimensions PDF
notes: The thread identifies an attachment titled Porsche 993 body dimensions small.pdf, about 1.06 MB, requested for garage dimensions and then reused as a body/chassis reference. Two attachment variants are also found in the public Rennlist index: Porsche 993 body measurement PDF (773.6 kB, announced as a table of points in millimeters) and temp body structure dimensions PDF (1.0 MB, announced as structure diagrams). The discussion repeats in particular 4,245 mm length, 1,735 mm width and 2,272 mm wheelbase for a Carrera 2, but the origin, protocol and technical lineage of the PDFs are not established here.
